rationale: Targeted check graded all 4 prior blocking findings against HEAD 47783ead: CR-001 (signal subsystem extracted to signal-handlers.ts), CR-002 (win32 handler kills with no signal name, so no ENOSYS throw), CR-004 (self-exit test asserts exitSignals) are resolved in source, and CR-003 is resolved by a recorded product-owner decision keeping the PR's Scope. business_review and standards_review are carried forward from the final round unchanged; 1 deferred item was not re-checked.

business_review.item: On SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP the wrapper forwards the signal to the agent, waits (bounded) for exit and SessionEnd, then stops the proxy
business_review.notes: POSIX forwards all three and keeps the proxy; 10 s fallback only for SIGTERM/SIGHUP, SIGINT wait unbounded; win32 kills the child instead of forwarding (CR-003)

business_review.item: Session is finalized (completed, endTime set) and the end metric is delivered or persisted for retry
business_review.notes: child-exit path runs grace -> endSessionAndCleanup -> proxy stop for every signal incl. after fallback; delivery is runtime evidence

business_review.item: SIGTERM/SIGINT to the wrapper: SessionEnd hook completes with the proxy still running; end metric delivered (no fetch failed)
business_review.notes: cleanup-before-kill handler removed; ordering covered by signals test; live delivery is Stage 7 evidence

business_review.item: SIGHUP to the wrapper: session is finalized with endTime and not left active
business_review.notes: POSIX SIGHUP handler kept until exit path ends; EIO/EPIPE guard; win32 SIGHUP path crashes (CR-002)

business_review.item: Proxy stop happens only after the child exits or after a bounded timeout
business_review.notes: signal handlers never stop the proxy; proxy.stop only via endSessionAndCleanup in exit/error handlers

business_review.item: Automated test covers signal -> child exit -> proxy stop ordering
business_review.notes: BaseAgentAdapter.signals.test.ts asserts kill -> onSessionEnd -> proxyStop plus fallback/SIGHUP/win32 variants

business_review.item: Root cause: signal handler must not run cleanup() (proxy stop) before child kill/exit
business_review.notes: handleSignal with await cleanup() removed; installSignalHandlers dispatcher

business_review.item: Root cause: register a SIGHUP handler
business_review.notes: SIGHUP forwarded on POSIX; process.once('SIGHUP') on win32

business_review.item: Root cause: bin/codemie.js rethrows EIO when the TTY is closed
business_review.notes: entry-point error listeners replaced at run() start by onOutputStreamError ignoring EIO/EPIPE

business_review.item: PR: forward signals to the agent's whole process tree (signalTree, pgrep -P, deepest first)
business_review.notes: signalTree/listChildPids in src/utils/processes.ts; ESRCH skipped; pgrep timeout 1000 ms

business_review.item: PR: SIGTERM/SIGHUP 10 s fallback kills the tree, exit path finalizes, wrapper exits 128 + signal; SIGINT arms nothing
business_review.notes: signalFallbackTimer unref'd; finally process.exit(128 + signal); tests 143/129

business_review.item: PR: after the agent exits SIGINT/SIGTERM take default action again; late SIGHUP ignored
business_review.notes: removeInterruptHandlers at exit-handler start; childExited guard

business_review.item: PR: stdout/stderr ignore EIO/EPIPE from run() start until process end; others re-thrown
business_review.notes: ignoreClosedOutputStreams first in run(); output-streams test suite

business_review.item: PR: Windows handler no longer stops proxy first; SIGHUP (console close) takes same path
business_review.notes: ordering correct, but child.kill('SIGHUP') throws on win32 (CR-002)

business_review.item: PR: conversations API client clears the per-attempt abort timer once request and body read settle
business_review.notes: clearTimeout in finally around fetch + body read; getTimerCount()==0 test

business_review.item: PR: OTLP plugin clears the 5 s shutdown-flush cap timer once flush settles
PR: child-exit handler runs in try/finally so handler removal and fallback exit survive a throw
business_review.notes: finally removes handlers and exits 128+signal; afterRun-throws test

business_review.item: PR: npm run ci green and live manual scenarios

standards_review.notes: all 6 subjects in the range use <type>(<scope>): <subject> with allowed type fix and allowed scope agents, imperative mood, each under the 100-char subject-max-length

new exports (signalTree, resetOutputStreamGuardForTests) carry explicit return types and JSDoc, imports use .js, constants are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, no new console.log; but code-quality.md Code Structure Guidelines require files under 500 lines and this change adds ~200 lines of signal-handling code (SignalHandlers, ignoreClosedOutputStreams, installWin32SignalHandlers, installPosixSignalHandlers) to src/agents/core/BaseAgentAdapter.ts, now 1583 lines

no attribution header added/removed/rewritten (apiClient.ts change only moves the abort timer around the body read); no new secret logging; signalTree spawns pgrep via execFileSync with an argv array and a numeric pid, no shell; no user-input paths introduced

finding_status.notes: Signal subsystem and output-stream guard moved to src/agents/core/signal-handlers.ts (171 lines) and imported; BaseAgentAdapter.ts drops to 1427 lines, below its pre-change size
installWin32SignalHandlers now calls child.kill() with no signal name for SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP; win32 test asserts kill:default and not.toThrow for each
fix_evidence decision: product owner keeps the PR Scope (SIGTERM/SIGHUP bounded 10 s, SIGINT unbounded, Windows terminates) with a non-empty rationale
Self-exit SIGTERM test (signals.test.ts:187) now asserts exitSignals equals ['SIGTERM'], pinning the fallbackSignal() ?? signal branch
